content.short: Pencils Protocol is the premier DeFi hub on Scroll featuring yield optimization, staking, and a launchpad.
content.description:
Pencils Protocol is the definitive decentralized finance gateway and yield powerhouse built natively for the Scroll ZK-rollup ecosystem. Formerly known as PenPad, the platform provides a comprehensive suite of DeFi services, including professional-grade automated vaults for leveraged yield farming and secure asset staking. Pencils Protocol serves as a primary hub for project bootstrapping through its integrated launchpad, enabling new protocols to engage with the Scroll community and build initial liquidity in a transparent manner.

Powered by the $DAPP token, the protocol features a robust governance model and a sustainable reward framework that incentivizes long-term participation. By leveraging Scroll's high-speed and low-cost infrastructure, Pencils Protocol delivers a seamless user experience while inheriting the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet. As a cornerstone of the Scroll decentralized economy, the project is dedicated to providing the essential financial tools needed for participants to maximize their capital efficiency and explore the next generation of on-chain finance.
